errorState.body: The request failed. Check your connection and try again. If it keeps failing, check System status.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist or isn't available in this version.

renderError.heading: Something went wrong
renderError.body: This page failed to load. Reload to try again.

apiError.title: Request failed
apiError.fallback: The server rejected the request. Try again.

serverError.title: Server error
serverError.description: The server hit a problem. Try again in a moment.

network.title: Can't reach the server
network.description: Check your connection and try again.

timeout.title: Request timed out
timeout.description: The server took too long to respond. Try again.

login.title: Sign in to devRag
login.registrationOff: New accounts are turned off on this server.

error.tooLarge: That upload is too large to save. Choose a smaller image and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

passwordChanged.title: Password changed
passwordChanged.body: Sign in with your new password.

step1.title: Reset your password
step1.body: Enter your account email. We'll send a 6-digit code.

step2.title: Enter the code
step2.body: If an account exists for {{email}}, a 6-digit code is on its way. It expires in 10 minutes.

forgot.resent: A new code is on its way.
forgot.codeFallback: That code is incorrect or has expired.
forgot.sessionFallback: This reset session is invalid or has expired. Request a new code.

step3.title: Choose a new password
step3.body: You'll be signed out on every device.

forgot.doneBody: Sign in with your new password.

nickname.invalid: This nickname contains characters that are not allowed.

avatar.type: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
avatar.decode: That file couldn't be read as an image. Choose a different PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
avatar.size: That image is still over 256 KB after resizing. Choose a smaller one.

avatar.help: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Resized to 256 by 256 pixels, up to 256 KB.

password.title: Password
password.note: Changing your password signs you out on every device. Signing out on any device also signs you out everywhere.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: Use an API token to call the devRag API from your own code. Send it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

copyFailed.title: Couldn't copy
copyFailed.body: Select the token and copy it manually.

empty.heading: No API tokens yet
empty.body: Create a token to call the devRag API from your own code.

created.title: API token created
created.body: Treat this token like a password. Anyone who has it can act as you in this workspace. You can view it again from this page.

delete.title: Delete API token?
delete.body: The token ending {{last4}} stops working immediately, and anything using it will get an authentication error. This can't be undone.

forbidden.heading: Only the workspace owner can manage API tokens
forbidden.body: Ask the owner of this workspace if you need a token.

limit.title: Token limit reached
limit.body: This workspace already has {{max}} API tokens. Delete one you no longer use, then try again.

rateLimited.title: Too many tokens created
rateLimited.body: Too many tokens were created recently. Wait a while, then try again.

error.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can create API tokens.

delete.title: Couldn't delete token
delete.body: Something went wrong. The token was not deleted. Try again.

team.title: Team
team.intro: The owner invites people and manages roles. Admins and members can use the workspace.

invite.help: They need a devRag account already. The invitation appears on their Team page.
invite.sentBody: {{email}} can accept it from their Team page.

error.forbidden: Only the workspace owner can invite people.
error.rateLimited: Too many invitations were sent. Try again in a little while.
error.rateLimitedIn: Too many invitations were sent. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

remove.label: Remove {{nickname}}
remove.title: Remove {{nickname}}?
remove.body: {{nickname}} loses access to {{workspace}} immediately. You can invite them again later.

withdraw.label: Withdraw invitation for {{email}}
withdraw.title: Withdraw invitation?
withdraw.body: {{email}} will no longer be able to join {{workspace}}. You can invite them again later.

team.noTeammates: No teammates yet. Invite someone with a devRag account to share this workspace.

leave.label: Leave {{workspace}}
leave.title: Leave {{workspace}}?
leave.body: You lose access to {{workspace}}. The owner would have to invite you again for you to rejoin.

error.gone: That is no longer available. The list has been refreshed.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
error.rateLimited: Too many changes in a short time. Wait a moment, then try again.
error.generic: The change wasn't saved. The list has been refreshed. Try again.
